name: Strait of Hormuz
description: Critical chokepoint handling roughly one-fifth of global oil transit and about 43% of India's crude import exposure.

name: Red Sea
description: Red Sea / Bab-el-Mandeb route with about 30% India-linked crude flow exposure, including Russia/Europe-adjacent long-haul routing.

name: Iran Exports
description: Direct Iran-linked crude exposure is 2% or less under sanctions constraints, but disruptions still indicate broader Gulf risk.

name: Persian Gulf
description: Broader Persian Gulf shipping lanes covering Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Kuwait, and UAE exports, representing about 54% of India's crude supplier mix.

name: Suez Canal
description: Egypt's Suez Canal shortcut for Europe-Asia oil trade, with about 32% exposure when Russia/Europe-linked flows and rerouting dependencies are included.

name: Cape of Good Hope
description: Alternative long-haul route around Africa with about 8% exposure as Red Sea and Suez disruptions push tankers onto costlier routes.
